units.rawText: If I get the chance, I'd love to invite you to the Rossum Sector as a guest.

units.rawText: Although we're still facing the Entropic threat, we can rebuild from them as many times as needed, so long Turing and I are there and those agents combine their efforts.

units.rawText: Someday, I want to fulfil my duties as an administrator... and make Rossum as wonderful as the Oasis.
